Subject: game theory | ID: 28690

Step 2. Applying the smooth interpolation theorem to \(A_{01370012}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Step 3. By compactness of the simplex spectral family \(A_{01370013}\), the image is precompact in the real manifold topology.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the asymptotic convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01370011 \cdot C_01370012 \cdot C_01370013\).
